definition: עֲנַמֶּ֫לֶךְ proper name, of a divinity of סְפַרְוַיִם (q. v.) 2Kgs 17:31 , Ανημελεχ (omitted by ᵐ5 L ); = Assyrian Anu-malik according to Schr COT on the passage , but dubious, see Kit on the passage and references ; Che Expos. Times, June, 1898, 429 reads ענומלך , and insert also 2Kgs 19:37 (before אלהיו ); compare also Hal cited below עֲנָת .
